title: Creative Machines Grant 2027
desc: Six grants of €25,000 for artists, musicians and filmmakers building with emerging technology, with a year of mentorship from past recipients.
body: The Creative Machines Grant supports practitioners who use new tools in service of a clear artistic intent. The foundation is less interested in technical novelty than in work where the person stays in charge of the result.

Recipients receive €25,000 paid in two instalments, monthly mentorship sessions, and a group showing at the end of the year. There are no restrictions on how the money is spent, but recipients file a short public process note at the end of the grant.
elig: Individuals or collectives of up to three people
At least two years of practice in your field
steps: Write a project outline of up to 800 words
Share up to ten images, audio or video samples
Add a tools-used note describing how technology is involved
Submit on the Northlight site before 23:59 CET on the deadline
orgAbout: An independent foundation funding art and technology since 2009. Has awarded €4.2M to 180 practitioners in 31 countries.
